body: Can you check if `--headless` works as a base case? Then we can investigate opengl working.

Headless looks like it’s working:
/data/local/tmp # ./t2-script.sh
Godot Engine v4.4.beta.custom_build.eee39f004 (2025-02-03 17:14:44 UTC) - https://godotengine.org
WARNING: Started the engine as `root`/superuser. This is a security risk, and subsystems like audio may not work correctly.
Set the environment variable `GODOT_SILENCE_ROOT_WARNING` to 1 to silence this warning.
     at: setup2 (main/main.cpp:3173)

OpenGL ES also works fine, I have a simple OpenGL ES app that runs and shows the result on the display.

Please let me know what you think and how can I investigate this issue.

Thanks
